{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_InClass_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                public partial class OuterClass\n                {\n                    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n                    public partial class MyResolver\n                    {\n                    }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class SampleObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await AssertNestedCompositeResolverAsync(source, \"TempProject.OuterClass+MyResolver\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_InStruct_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                public partial struct OuterStruct\n                {\n                    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n                    public partial class MyResolver\n                    {\n                    }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class SampleObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await AssertNestedCompositeResolverAsync(source, \"TempProject.OuterStruct+MyResolver\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertNestedCompositeResolverAsync(string source, string resolverMetadataName)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkRefs\n            .Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack))\n            .ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult[] generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult resolverSource = Assert.Single(\n            generatedSources,\n            s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class MyResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        string resolverCode = resolverSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", resolverCode, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        Diagnostic[] compilationErrors = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToArray();\n        Assert.True(\n            compilationErrors.Length == 0,\n            \"Compilation errors: \" + string.Join(\" | \", compilationErrors.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n\n        using MemoryStream peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = outputCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(\n            emitResult.Success,\n            \"Emit failed: \" + string.Join(\" | \", emitResult.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(resolverMetadataName);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterCacheSymbol = Assert.Single(resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\"));\n        Assert.Equal(1, formatterCacheSymbol.Arity);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n}"
}
